nary_nodes.label: Flores earthquake
evidence: Rescuers combed through debris for survivors on Saturday after a powerful earthquake struck off Indonesia's eastern Flores island, killing at least 47 people, according to disaster officials.
The national disaster management agency (BNPB) raised the death toll from 40 late Saturday, and rescue official Fathur Rahman said 50 people were injured in the 7.7-magnitude quake.
Nearly 160 houses, dozens of educational and health facilities and other public buildings were damaged when the earthquake struck the popular tourist island in Indonesia's east, the BNPB reported.
The epicentre of the shallow quake was located just off the north coast of the island, US and Indonesian authorities said.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of ground shaking caused by seismic activity.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Flores and Sumatra earthquakes are earthquake events; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: Sumatra earthquake
evidence: A second, deep onland quake was measured at a magnitude of 6.9 near Pematangsiantar on Sumatra island – thousands of kilometres away – some 12 hours after the Flores tremor.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of ground shaking caused by seismic activity.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Flores and Sumatra earthquakes are earthquake events; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: Rescue efforts
evidence: Rescuers combed through debris for survivors on Saturday after a powerful earthquake struck off Indonesia's eastern Flores island, killing at least 47 people, according to disaster officials.
Rescue official Fathur told AFP the focus was on locating victims who may be buried under rubble, but rescue efforts have been complicated by landslides cutting off roads.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An organized effort to save people from danger or disaster.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Rescue efforts are rescue operations; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: Aid delivery
evidence: The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies said preparations were under way to bring aid to some 2,000 people in temporary shelters.
The government sent 50,000 aid packages weighing a total of 275 tonnes to the area, and European Union chief Ursula von der Leyen offered help from the bloc's Copernicus Earth observation satellites.
nary_nodes.type_definition: The act of delivering assistance, such as food, supplies, or medical care, to those in need.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Aid delivery is an event of delivering aid; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: Evacuation of residents
evidence: Residents in Nagekeo, an area close to the epicentre, raced for higher ground as the sea retreated early Saturday – a possible sign of an approaching tsunami, AFP journalists witnessed.
Hundreds remained outside hours later as dozens of aftershocks shook the island, the strongest measured at a magnitude of 6.1.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of moving people from a dangerous place to safety.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Evacuation of residents is an evacuation event; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: Tsunami warning
evidence: While a tsunami warning was lifted, authorities urged people not to return to damaged buildings for fear that aftershocks may bring them down.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of issuing a warning for a potential tsunami.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Tsunami warning is an event of issuing a warning; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

evidence: Hundreds remained outside hours later as dozens of aftershocks shook the island, the strongest measured at a magnitude of 6.1.
nary_nodes.type_definition: A smaller earthquake that follows a larger one in the same area.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Aftershocks are seismic events; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: 1992 Flores earthquake
evidence: Flores was struck by a 7.7-magnitude earthquake in 1992, which triggered a tsunami and resulted in around 2,500 deaths.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An earthquake that occurred in the past, often studied for its impact.
nary_nodes.type_justification: 1992 Flores and 2004 Sumatra earthquakes are historical earthquakes; no candidate matches, so minting with parent Event.

nary_nodes.label: 2004 Sumatra earthquake
evidence: A devastating 9.1-magnitude tremor in 2004 struck off the coast of Sumatra and triggered a tsunami that killed 220,000 throughout the region, about 170,000 of them in Indonesia, in one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.

nary_nodes.label: Death toll raised
evidence: The national disaster management agency (BNPB) raised the death toll from 40 late Saturday, and rescue official Fathur Rahman said 50 people were injured in the 7.7-magnitude quake.

nary_nodes.label: People trapped
evidence: Suharyanto, who leads the BNPB, said earlier that people were trapped in several buildings.

nary_nodes.label: Yulian's experience
evidence: "I have never felt an earthquake this big," Yulian Juita Ekalia, who lives in Ruteng city more than 100 kilometres (60 miles) west of the epicentre, told AFP by telephone hours after the tremor.
"It felt like we were on a trampoline; it was really scary," said the 37-year-old university lecturer, who was jolted awake at around 5:30am (21:30 GMT on Friday).

"As I rushed to get outside, everything in the house fell down: the television, my son's trophies, the dish racks, suitcases on top of the wardrobes. When I got outside, my son and neighbours were already there, screaming in fear."

nary_nodes.label: Yohanes's experience
evidence: Nagekeo resident Yohanes Babo, 56, said he was at a market when the earth started shaking in the early morning hours.
"The shaking was strong. Thankfully, we were already outside the house," he told AFP.
"People were panicking, running here and there. We're evacuating for the time being... and trying to get to the hills," he said.

nary_nodes.label: EU offers help
evidence: " Europe stands ready to deploy Copernicus, our eyes in the sky, to support search and rescue efforts. Indonesia, we stand with you," she wrote on X.
